role: Independent AI read-only archive/inventory/source-byte review; no native-host or human acceptance

currentSourceReadback.scope: Compare every archive payload file to current formal tree; compare selection to current source_paths allowlist. This does not certify undeclared transitive dependencies.

standaloneReadback.scope: Read-only installed inventory/hash/schema check; Root performed extraction and install.

limits: Checksum inventory is not a publisher signature.
No host E2E, user model execution, human study, publication review or public release is inferred.
Safety code review is separately bound to independent-review.json and independent-safety-final-v2.json.
